comment: Known-dead routes between the declared capability registry (workers/nitro-worker/src/capabilities.js), the measured host route table (workers/nitro-enclave-host/src/routes.rs) and the web proxies (apps/web/app/api/**/route.*). This is a RECORD OF DEBT, not an allowance, and it only shrinks. scripts/check-capability-route-parity.mjs enforces that in the tree on every run: every dead lane must be listed; an entry that is not actually dead fails; every entry needs a reason, an owner and an expires that is a real date, later than today and at most 60 days away; and a proxy entry pins the target and method it was recorded with, so re-pointing a proxy at another dead route fails. CI also runs the gate with --base <the pull request's base commit>: an entry that is not in the base file, a later expires, or a re-pointed proxy fails. Deleting an entry is the only edit that passes both, and it is what CU-149 does when it adds the read-only catalog routes to the host and repairs or removes the dead proxies. An entry may never be added to admit a newly declared lane: that is the failure the gate exists to catch. Same 'absence without a dated record is a hard failure' rule as deploy/nitro/kms/attestation-pins.json.
recorded_against: neo-os-services main 9c3019c (the three route sources are byte-identical on main 0c45a78)

Transaction submission goes through the relayer, not the enclave.

dead_web_proxies.reason: Unlike the other three, the host DOES classify /sign/payload (Target::SignPayload), but sign.rs closes blind payload signing with a 503 unless the measured image sets ENCLAVE_ALLOW_BLIND_SIGN=1. The shipped posture is closed and scripts/custody-plane-e2e.mjs asserts it, so this proxy reaches nothing a caller can use. Counted dead because the lane refuses in the shipped posture, which is why this proxy is in the baseline while sign_payload is not in dead_capability_ids.
dead_web_proxies.owner: neo-os-services platform operator (CU-149 removes the proxy; the lane itself is a deliberate security retirement, not a gap)

dead_web_proxies.reason: The host serves /keys/derived for POST only (classify falls through to NotFound on a method mismatch) and this runtime-token-gated proxy sends GET, so an authorised caller gets the host 404. A path-only comparison lists it as live. scripts/publish-oracle-verifier-key.mjs:51 sends the same GET straight to the host.
dead_web_proxies.owner: neo-os-services platform operator (CU-149 repairs or removes the proxy)
